description: Compare two versions of a Motion Vitals project, the way its Versions page does: hitch time, slow and frozen frames, janky sessions, and every problem call site as Worse, Came back, New, Still there, Better, Fixed or Ignored, with its drop rate in each version. Default: the latest version against the one before it with enough sessions. After a fix ships, it says whether the field problem is Fixed. Needs KEYFRAMER_VITALS_READ_KEY.

from.description: The older version. Default: the one before to with enough sessions.

project.description: The project: its code (SHOP) or its id.

to.description: The newer version. Default: the latest.

name: field_compare
